name: space-arena
description: Space Arena Lab 06 — strict TypeScript shared simulation, Zod protocol and typed realtime networking

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types --test client/tests/*.test.js server/test/*.test.js shared/test/*.test.js shared/test/*.test.ts server/test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
